page.overview:
What is New Vegas?

New Vegas is a post-War city established in the ruins of the pre-War city of Las Vegas, Nevada in the Mojave Wasteland, with the most prominent fixture being the New Vegas Strip controlled by the enigmatic Mr — part of Fallout.

House and his Three Families who govern the Strip's casinos. It appears as a major location in the eponymous as well as.

Unlike other major cities of the United States, Vegas emerged from the Great War relatively unscathed, entirely due to the preemptive actions of Robert House, a native of Las Vegas.

Also known as: The Strip, Vegas.
